svg.text: A Coloring Journey Through the Solar System
Blast off with Zeytin, a fluffy black-and-
white space cat with a pirate eye patch, on a
journey from Earth all the way to Pluto — and
Color real science on every page: glowing
auroras, footprints on the Moon, sunspots,
Olympus Mons, Saturn’s icy rings, the geysers
of Triton and Pluto’s giant heart.
At each stop, a big detailed coloring page
sits next to a short, true story packed with
Best with colored pencils or crayons.
